refinedPriorNodes.label: AgentServiceR15
refinedPriorNodes.refinement: R16 exposes only source/architecture/deployment qualification around R15; it does not instantiate the R15 state machine, open a production database, or expose delivery/effect mutations.

discoveredNodes.label: AgentServiceReadOnlyMcpFacade
discoveredNodes.reason: A loopback-only authenticated stateless MCP facade provides deployment qualification without exposing semantic mutation or provider effects.

discoveredNodes.label: AgentServiceCanaryDeployment
discoveredNodes.reason: A parallel canary process binds the read-only facade, pinned MCP dependencies and hardened systemd execution without replacing the legacy Agent Automation service.

flow: R15 source acceptance and graph identity
N92 isolated canary process on port 8894
future explicit promotion gate before any write/effect surface
authorityLaws: R16 exposes no Session, Delegation, route, credential, delivery, Runtime mutation, Host mutation or provider-effect tool.
R16 binds literal loopback only and requires a private bearer token.
R16 uses MCP stateless HTTP and validates the current source acceptance/graph before serving its qualification surface.
R16 productionDeployment remains NOT_ADMITTED even when the canary daemon is healthy.
R16 does not replace or disable the legacy Agent Automation MCP.
A healthy R16 canary proves source-to-daemon-to-MCP reachability only; it does not prove provider admission, semantic acceptance or end-to-end Agent throughput.
Any future write/effect tool requires a new explicit architecture and acceptance slice rather than silently extending the read-only canary.

standardsBasis.use: Stateless HTTP core and self-describing requests fit an independently deployable local control-plane facade.
External A2A server exposure is deliberately deferred because it introduces Agent Card, TLS, authentication and per-operation authorization server responsibilities not needed for this local canary.
